sentences.text: Michael Shawn Hickenbottom -LRB- born July 22 , 1965 -RRB- , better known by his ring name Shawn Michaels , is an American actor , professional wrestling personality , television presenter and retired professional wrestler .	ring name	ring name	professional wrestling	professional wrestling	television presenter	television presenter	professional wrestler	Professional wrestling
He is currently signed to WWE , as an ambassador and trainer , since December 2010 .	WWE	WWE	ambassador	ambassador
Michaels wrestled consistently for WWE , formerly the World Wrestling Federation -LRB- WWF -RRB- , from 1988 until his first retirement in 1998 .	WWE	WWE
He held non-wrestling roles from 1998 to 2000 and resumed wrestling in 2002 until retiring ceremoniously in 2010 .

In the WWF/E , Michaels headlined major pay-per-view events between 1989 and 2010 , closing the company 's flagship annual event , WrestleMania , five times .	pay-per-view	pay-per-view	WrestleMania	WrestleMania
He was the co-founder and original leader of the successful stable , D-Generation X .	D-Generation X	D-Generation X

He also wrestled in the American Wrestling Association -LRB- AWA -RRB- , where he founded The Midnight Rockers with Marty Jannetty in 1985 .	American Wrestling Association	American Wrestling Association	The Midnight Rockers	The Rockers	Marty Jannetty	Marty Jannetty
After winning the AWA Tag Team Championship twice , the team continued to the WWF as The Rockers , and had a high-profile breakup in January 1992 .	AWA Tag Team Championship	AWA Tag Team Championship

Within the year , Michaels would twice challenge for the WWF Championship and win his first WWF Intercontinental Championship , heralding his arrival as one of the industry 's premier singles stars .	WWF Championship	WWE Championship	WWF Intercontinental Championship	WWE Intercontinental Championship

He would go on to be widely regarded as its finest performer in the 1990s and 2000s , winning the Pro Wrestling Illustrated `` Match of the Year '' reader vote a record eleven times .	Pro Wrestling Illustrated	Pro Wrestling Illustrated	Match of the Year	List of Pro Wrestling Illustrated awards#Match of the Year
Michaels was voted the greatest professional wrestler of all time in a 2011 poll of the WWE roster .	professional wrestler	Professional wrestling	WWE	WWE

Michaels is a four-time world champion , having held the WWF Championship three times and WWE 's World Heavyweight Championship once .	WWE	WWE	WWF Championship	WWE Championship	world champion	Professional wrestling championship#World championships	three times	List of WWE Champions	World Heavyweight Championship	World Heavyweight Championship (WWE)	once	List of World Heavyweight Champions (WWE)

He is also a two-time Royal Rumble winner , the first WWF Grand Slam Champion and the fourth WWF Triple Crown Champion , as well as a 2011 WWE Hall of Fame inductee .
